## 简体中文

### 修复

- 修复同时按下 Option 与空格或其他按键后开始菜单仍会打开的问题。
- 将单独按下 Option 的手势检测移至只读会话事件 tap，让组合键可以在其他全局快捷键消费事件前被识别。
- 保持 Command-Option-Space 等已配置的 Carbon 全局快捷键行为不变。
- 无法安装事件 tap 时安全关闭单 Option 手势，避免误触发。

## English

### Fixed

- Fixed the Start menu opening after pressing Option together with Space or another key.
- Moved single-Option gesture detection to a read-only session event tap so key combinations are observed before another global shortcut consumes them.
- Kept configured Carbon global shortcuts such as Command-Option-Space unchanged.
- Disabled the single-Option gesture safely when the event tap cannot be installed, preventing false activations.
